propositions: AGENTS.md documents the 800-LOC module-size gate but omits documentation of the sibling C901 cyclomatic-complexity shrink-only ratchet, leaving implementers unaware of a structural CI failure mode

The C901 complexity ratchet (max 15 McCabe per function, baseline in .github/complexity-baseline.json) fails when adding guards or branches to existing functions even if total module LOC stays under the cap, forcing unplanned extraction passes

Adding documentation to AGENTS.md next to the module-size policy section explaining the complexity ratchet, its enforcement mechanism (make lint/ruff check --select C901), the baseline file location, and the shrink-only remedy will surface this constraint earlier to implementers
The fix remediation is behavior-preserving extraction of complex functions, never baseline bumping, and this must be crosslinked in the rebar-implement skill briefs
